evidence.why: Credentials are encrypted via Electron safeStorage before being persisted, not stored in cleartext.
Only the encrypted ciphertext is written to electron-store, not the plain password.

controls_present: Electron safeStorage encryption (OS keychain/DPAPI-backed) before persistence
other_classes_observed: No IPC sender frame origin allowlist check beyond null check
In-memory caching of plaintext credentials object
